title: fevm portal
tagline: i made a small site where i can have everything regarding fevm in one place
description:
one of the main things i stuggles with the most during this hackthon was that information to build on top of the fevm is all over the place and i have to jump from one site to the other in order to find something i want, so i wanted to build something that have everything in one place. 

and while im still far away from completing that, I imagine this will be an ongoing project that i will continue to work on and update .
how_its_made: this project is build using nextjs as the front-end framework, it also uses coingeck api to fetch the fil price data , in addition to that it uses zondax api to fetch information like the latest tipset and information about the accounts , it also incorporate filrep api to showcase information about the miners both in the mainnet and in addition in the testnet (soon)
